title: Configure, split and upgrade providers
scenario:
Your organization keeps its reporting platform in `/home/coder/lab`: the security group `web-<build number>` (the number comes from `random_integer.build`) and the `reports` module with the S3 bucket `acme-reports-east`. The configuration was applied last week. Since then a colleague changed `modules/reports`, and now `terraform init` fails. The business also wants a copy of the reports in `us-west-2` for disaster recovery.

The configuration was initialized and applied before the colleague's change. **No existing resource may be destroyed or recreated in this lab.** The `aws` CLI is configured for the account and region `us-east-1`; use `--region us-west-2` for the other region.

tasks.text:
Find out why `terraform init` fails and fix it in `modules/reports`.

- Don't change the AWS version constraint of the root module.

Hint: the error names the conflicting constraints. `terraform providers` lists the constraints of every module, and `.terraform.lock.hcl` shows the selected version. Read [Version constraints](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/expressions/version-constraints).
tasks.validation: Run `terraform init`. It should finish with `Terraform has been successfully initialized!`

tasks.text:
Create the disaster recovery bucket in `us-west-2`.

- Add a second `aws` provider configuration with the alias `west` and the region `us-west-2`.
- Create `aws_s3_bucket.replica` with the name `acme-reports-west` in the root module and select the provider with `provider = aws.west`.

Hint: [Multiple provider configurations](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/providers/configuration#alias-multiple-provider-configurations).
tasks.validation: Run `aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket acme-reports-west`. The `LocationConstraint` should be `us-west-2`.

tasks.text:
Upgrade the `random` provider from `3.1.0` to the newest `3.6.x` release.

- Change the constraint to `~> 3.6.0` and update the dependency lock file.
- `random_integer.build` must keep its value.

Hint: `terraform init` keeps the locked version until you run `terraform init -upgrade`. See [Dependency lock file](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/files/dependency-lock).
tasks.validation: Run `terraform version`. It should list `provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random v3.6.3`.

tasks.text:
Tag every AWS resource with `ManagedBy = terraform`.

- Set the tag once per provider configuration with `default_tags`, not on each resource.
- Finish with a clean workspace.

Hint: [default_tags](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#default_tags-configuration-block) in the AWS provider docs.
tasks.validation: Run `aws s3api get-bucket-tagging --bucket acme-reports-west`. It should show `ManagedBy = terraform`, and `terraform plan` should report no changes.

tasks.text:
Make `terraform init` succeed again.

- Fix the cause in `modules/reports`.
- Don't change the AWS version constraint of the root module, and keep the AWS provider version recorded in `.terraform.lock.hcl`.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform init`. It should finish with `Terraform has been successfully initialized!`

tasks.text:
Let `module.reports` create the bucket `acme-reports-west` in `us-west-2` as `module.reports.aws_s3_bucket.replica`.

- Add an `aws` provider configuration with the alias `west` in the root module and pass it to the module with the `providers` meta-argument.
- The module must declare the configuration it expects with `configuration_aliases` and must not contain `provider` blocks.
- Add the output `replica_bucket` to the module.
tasks.validation: Run `aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket acme-reports-west`. The `LocationConstraint` should be `us-west-2`.

tasks.text:
Upgrade the `random` provider to the newest `3.6.x` release.

- The root constraint must allow only `3.6.x` patch releases.
- Record the new version in `.terraform.lock.hcl`.
- `random_integer.build` must not be recreated.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform version`. It should list `provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random v3.6.3`.

tasks.text:
Tag every AWS resource in both regions with `ManagedBy = terraform`.

- Don't repeat the tag on each resource.
- No existing resource may be recreated. Finish with a clean workspace.
tasks.validation: Run `aws s3api get-bucket-tagging --bucket acme-reports-east`. It should show `ManagedBy = terraform`, and `terraform plan` should report no changes.

tasks.text:
Make `terraform init` succeed again.

- Fix every version conflict. Don't change the AWS version constraint of the root module.
- In `modules/reports`, declare only minimum versions (`>=`) for its providers.
- In the root module, allow only `3.6.x` patch releases of `random`.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform init`. It should finish with `Terraform has been successfully initialized!`

tasks.text:
Extend the platform to `us-west-2`.

- Add an `aws` provider configuration with the alias `west`. Pass it to `module.reports` with the `providers` meta-argument; the module declares it with `configuration_aliases` and contains no `provider` blocks.
- `module.reports` creates `module.reports.aws_s3_bucket.replica` named `acme-reports-west` and outputs `replica_bucket`.
- Create the security group `aws_security_group.web_west` named `web-west-<build number>` (from the same `random_integer.build`, description `Web servers`) in the default VPC of `us-west-2`, looked up by the data source `data.aws_vpc.default_west`.
tasks.validation: Run `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region us-west-2`. The output should list `web-west-<build number>`, and `aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket acme-reports-west` should show `us-west-2`.

tasks.text:
Record the provider upgrade in `.terraform.lock.hcl`.

- `random` must be locked to the newest `3.6.x` release, and `aws` must stay at the version that was locked before.
- `random_integer.build` must not be recreated.
tasks.validation: Run `terraform version`. It should list `random v3.6.3` and the same `aws` version as before.

tasks.text:
Tag every AWS resource in both regions with `ManagedBy = terraform` and `Project = reports`.

- Set the tags once per provider configuration. Neither key may appear on a resource.
- Every resource must carry these values in AWS.
- No existing resource may be recreated. Finish with a clean workspace.
tasks.validation: Run `aws s3api get-bucket-tagging --bucket acme-reports-east`. It should show `ManagedBy = terraform` and `Project = reports`, and `terraform plan` should report no changes.
